map.按泵流量定油箱容积与回油缓冲。: Set tank volume and return-oil buffering by pump flow.
map.散热与沉淀容积校核。: Check heat dissipation and settling volume.
map.空气滤清与液位报警布置。: Arrange air breather and level alarm.
